description: This file contains the implementation of the WeightClass model in the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It defines methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving weight class data, descriptions, and total counts within the system.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Model class for managing weight class data, including CRUD operations and descriptions in different languages.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Inserts a new weight class into the database, adds descriptions for different languages, clears cache, and returns the new weight class ID.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Updates an existing weight class and its descriptions based on provided data, then clears cache.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Deletes a weight class and its descriptions from the database, then clears cache.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of weight classes with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific weight class by ID.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of weight classes in the system.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a weight class in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific weight class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description entries associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given weight class.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all weight class descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of weight classes filtered by unit.
